questions.prompt: 45 of 120 students chose cricket. What angle is the cricket slice of a pie chart?
Which graph best shows how a city's temperature changes over a year?
questions.explain: Line graphs show change over time.

questions.prompt: Which chart best shows how a whole day is split into activities?
questions.explain: Pie charts show parts of a whole.

questions.prompt: A pie chart of 200 students has a 72° slice for ‘walk to school’. How many students walk?
A bar chart's axis starts at 90 instead of 0. What effect does this have?
options: It makes the data more accurate
It shows the data as percentages
questions.explain: Bars of 95 and 100 can look like one is double the other.

questions.prompt: Bengaluru's rainfall (mm) from June to November is roughly 105, 115, 145, 210, 185, 55. Describe what a line graph of this data would show.
questions.modelAnswer: The line rises from June to a peak in September (about 210 mm), stays high in October, then drops sharply in November. So the wettest months are September and October, and the rains ease off by November.
questions.explain: Criterion C: describe a trend in words.

questions.prompt: Adam sleeps 9 hours in a 24-hour day. What angle is the sleep slice in a pie chart of his day?
Why are there gaps between the bars in a bar graph?
options: The categories are separate, not continuous
questions.explain: Separate categories (like sports) don't run into each other.
